exposure: Previous caesarean delivery (Cohort A) vs. no previous caesarean delivery (Cohort B)
cohort: 106 patients admitted for misoprostol-induced mid-trimester abortions at Combined Military Hospital (CMH) Nowshera, from January 2014 to June 2015
finding: The study found a significantly higher incidence of heavy blood loss, severe pain, and failure of induction in women with a history of previous caesarean deliveries undergoing misoprostol-induced mid-trimester abortions.
